categories.main_business_segments: Exact Sciences operates primarily in one business segment focused on advanced cancer diagnostics, with commercial teams dedicated to screening (notably colorectal cancer screening with Cologuard), precision oncology (Oncotype tests for breast, colon, and prostate cancers), and international markets. The company also provides COVID-19 testing and has expanded into hereditary cancer testing through recent acquisitions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include multi-target stool DNA (sDNA) testing (Cologuard), gene expression profiling (Oncotype DX), next-generation sequencing (oncomap, GEM ExTra), and proprietary algorithms for biomarker analysis. Production involves high-throughput, CLIA-certified and CAP-accredited laboratories, with manufacturing and assembly of test kits and reagents in-house and through select third-party suppliers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are healthcare providers (primary care, oncology, gastroenterology, women’s health), health systems, and patients, with a focus on average-risk adults for colorectal cancer screening and cancer patients for precision oncology tests. Major end markets include the U.S. healthcare system, Medicare/Medicaid, commercial insurers, and international public health systems for precision oncology.
categories.geographic_coverage: Exact Sciences’ main operations are in the United States, with significant laboratory and manufacturing facilities in Wisconsin, California, and Arizona. Internationally, the company markets Oncotype tests in over 90 countries, with direct operations in Canada, Japan, and several European countries, and is expanding local laboratory capacity in Germany.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates downstream in the supply chain, providing diagnostic testing services directly to healthcare providers and patients. It relies on upstream suppliers for specialized reagents, equipment, and components, and manages logistics for sample collection and kit distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the adoption of existing tests (Cologuard, Oncotype), developing new liquid biopsy and multi-cancer early detection (MCED) tests, enhancing test performance, and broadening hereditary cancer testing. R&D is focused on biomarker discovery, validation, and leveraging recent acquisitions and partnerships to accelerate innovation in early cancer detection and treatment guidance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from laboratory testing services billed to third-party payers (Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurers), direct bill payers, and patients. Additional revenue streams include international distributor payments, patient self-pay, and, to a lesser extent, COVID-19 testing services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include companies offering procedure-based cancer screening (e.g., colonoscopy), other molecular diagnostic firms (e.g., Guardant Health, Myriad Genetics, Natera, GRAIL), and large clinical labs (LabCorp, Quest Diagnostics). Exact Sciences is positioned as a leader in non-invasive cancer screening and gene expression-based precision oncology, with first-mover advantage in sDNA colorectal screening and strong clinical validation for Oncotype tests.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2021, Exact Sciences reported $1.77 billion in revenue, up from $1.49 billion in 2020, with significant investments in R&D and acquisitions. The company has a large accumulated deficit ($2.64 billion), reflecting ongoing investments and operating losses, but continues to grow test volumes and expand its product portfolio. As of year-end 2021, it had over 6,400 employees and substantial cash reserves ($1.03 billion).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Exact Sciences emphasizes earlier, non-invasive cancer detection and personalized treatment guidance, aiming to improve patient outcomes and reduce unnecessary treatments. Its products are differentiated by strong clinical validation, inclusion in major guidelines, broad reimbursement, patient-friendly sample collection, and proprietary biomarker and algorithmic technologies. The company’s adherence programs and direct-to-patient engagement further enhance test completion rates and customer value.
